title: FM27 Guides — Preview Players, Mods, Skins & Release Dates
description: Football Manager 27 guides for the Launch Preview: first wonderkids and bargain candidates, released mods and skins, tactics checks and the full access timeline.
meta: Updated 30 October 2026 · The PC/Mac Launch Preview is available now.
body:
The Football Manager 27 Launch Preview is playable now on PC and Mac. Start with the first sourced player candidates or check the released mods and skins below. Full digital release is 10 November 2026.

Choose your FM27 guide

  • FM27 free play — official download links, the deadline and access afterwards.
  • FM27 logo packs — choose a pack and troubleshoot missing badges.
  • FM27 wonderkids — Max Dowman, Rio Ngumoha and Rui Araki, with ages, positions and published fee estimates.
  • FM27 cheap players and bargains — Thomas Müller and Rui Araki, published fee ranges and save-specific contract checks.
  • FM27 mods — Real Name Fix V2, facepacks, logos and 2D-versus-3D kit compatibility.
  • FM27 skins — Priisek Retro 27 and Super League Turkey, with author installation notes and platform limitations.
  • FM27 tactics — how to assess a tactic’s test conditions and suitability for your squad.
  • FM27 release date and access — free Preview, paid Preview, platform dates and save continuity.

Free Preview and paid access

The free PC/Mac Preview runs from 29 October 2026 at 18:00 GMT to 3 November at 18:00 GMT. Sports Interactive lists Steam, Epic and the Microsoft Store, with access through Xbox Game Pass Ultimate or PC Game Pass for eligible subscribers. All game modes are included, and no additional sign-up is required.

From 3 November at 18:00 GMT, eligible pre-purchasers can continue in the paid Launch Preview until the 10 November launch; eligible Game Pass subscribers can continue through their subscription. Saves carry from free play into paid Preview and the full release.

Release dates and platforms

Digital releases start on 10 November 2026: PC/Mac, Console on Xbox and PS5, Mobile through Netflix and Touch on Apple Arcade. The official product FAQ lists 20 November for PS5 physical retail, so a digital release date should not be treated as the date for every edition. See the release-date guide for the breakdown.

The listed UK retail price is £49.99; the official Preview announcement offers 10% off through SEGA-approved retailers during pre-purchase. Check the selected store for your region and platform.

How to read Preview recommendations

Player entries name the database website or list revision and the date read. Published fee estimates are separate from negotiated transfer prices. Mod and skin entries distinguish an author’s compatibility statement from a file tested by this site; follow the original author’s current instructions.

Sports Interactive warns that Preview data and some club or player assets remain subject to rights-holder approval. The 10 November launch and later patches can change what you see, so record the game build, database selection and any installed updates when comparing results.
